source.items_origin: previously captured GET /client/items response bytes; no new request
source.locale_origin: previously captured English locale retained in session memory
source.consistency: separate retained responses, not server-atomic; not refreshed for this build
source.hash_format: sha256 of UTF-8 JSON, object order preserved, compact separators, ensure_ascii=false

migration.method: offline exact-decimal decode; both ordered source hashes verified

local_context.locale_precedence: base, then mod item locales; differing mod overrides are rejected
local_context.runtime_templates: unchanged; acquisition and compatibility are separate evidence
local_context.profile_state: not read; source conditions are not current-player unlock guarantees

objective.recoil_reduction_definition: 100 * (base_recoil - recoil_total) / abs(base_recoil); zero when base_recoil is zero
objective.numeric_model: exact template decimals; excludes IEEE-754 accumulation noise

constraints.state: unfolded, unloaded; no ammunition, skill, durability or dynamic recoil modifiers
